about: THE COACHES' VOICES (user 2026-11-24: "Give every coach a voice ... remember the voice for every coach making sure if I prompt you to make another voice line you are able to use the same voice"). Every coach line is made with ElevenLabs creative_generate_speech, model eleven_v4, generations_count 1, with the coach's voice_id below and a SHORT direction tag that fits the line's context (the tag's characters are charged too: about 1 credit a character). Context rule (user, same day): the delivery matches the moment, e.g. "Shake it off" after a miss is calm and supportive, a send-off slap is shouted hype. Every take is word-checked with the local faster-whisper check (D:/ClaudeScratch/coachvoices/wordcheck.py) before use. Library voices (fixed ids), not designed ones. Audio files stay outside the repo (D:/ClaudeScratch/coachvoices); this file keeps the voices, the tags and, once uploaded, the asset ids.

delivery_rules.about: THE USER'S ANSWERS, 2026-11-24 (after the first 138 takes came out too calm: "It has to be motivating it has to hype the player up"). Ask the user again before a new category (memory voice-context-questions).
delivery_rules.before_lift_R: intense, low growl (pushing hard up close, not yelling)
delivery_rules.missed_lift_M: fired up, 'forget it, we're getting the next one' (not sad)
delivery_rules.end_of_meet_E: great meet = loud and proud; bombed out = determined, already planning the comeback
delivery_rules.gym_talk_D: big personality: confident, a bit cocky, testing you, hyped when he becomes your coach
delivery_rules.trials_T_C: start = intense challenge; pass = hyped and impressed; fail = firm, come back stronger, not sad
delivery_rules.big_yell_H: screaming, ecstatic; only on big lifts (user 2026-11-25)
delivery_rules.end_scene_P: loud and proud after a good day; 4th or lower warm and encouraging; no total determined
